```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

# Load similarity data
similar_raw <- read_csv("data/similar_flags.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Build comprehensive country metadata
all_codes <- unique(c(similar_raw$code, similar_raw$similar_code))

countries <- tibble(code = all_codes) |>
  mutate(
    name = countrycode(toupper(code), origin = "iso2c", destination = "country.name", warn = FALSE),
    continent = countrycode(toupper(code), origin = "iso2c", destination = "continent", warn = FALSE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    name = case_when(
      code == "gb-eng" ~ "England",
      code == "gb-sct" ~ "Scotland",
      code == "gb-wls" ~ "Wales",
      code == "gb-nir" ~ "Northern Ireland",
      code == "xk" ~ "Kosovo",
      code == "bv" ~ "Bouvet Island",
      code == "sj" ~ "Svalbard & Jan Mayen",
      code == "um" ~ "U.S. Outlying Islands",
      code == "mf" ~ "Saint Martin",
      is.na(name) ~ toupper(code),
      TRUE ~ name
    ),
    continent = if_else(is.na(continent), "Territories & Others", continent)
  ) |>
  arrange(name)

# Attach names and compute intuitive similarity percentage
similar_df <- similar_raw |>
  left_join(countries |> select(code, name), by = "code") |>
  left_join(countries |> select(similar_code = code, similar_name = name), by = "similar_code") |>
  mutate(
    similarity_pct = case_when(
      distance == 0 ~ 100,
      distance < 0.002 ~ 100,
      TRUE ~ pmax(1, pmin(99, round(100 * exp(-distance * 1.7))))
    )
  )

# Pass structured datasets to Observable JS
ojs_define(
  countries_meta = countries,
  similarity_meta = similar_df
)
```

## 🔍 Interactive Flag Similarity Finder

Select any country to view its official flag and discover the flags with the closest visual patterns and color palettes.

::: {.content-card}

```{ojs}
// Transform datasets for OJS
countries = transpose(countries_meta)
similarities = transpose(similarity_meta)
```

```{ojs}
viewof selected_code = Inputs.select(
  countries.map(d => d.code),
  {
    label: "Select Country:",
    format: code => {
      const item = countries.find(d => d.code === code);
      return item ? `${item.name} (${item.continent})` : code;
    },
    value: "eg"
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
selected_country = countries.find(d => d.code === selected_code)
top_similar = similarities.filter(d => d.code === selected_code).slice(0, 5)
```

          </div>

            <div class="progress-bar-bg">
              <div class="progress-bar-fill" style="width: ${pct}%; background: ${barColor};"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    })}
  </div>
</div>
